name: wgslender-vscode
description: WGSL (WebGPU Shading Language) language server, minifier, linter, and binary-shader compiler powered by wgslender.

wgslender.rules.description: Per-rule severity overrides. Keys are rule ids; values are 'off' | 'warn' | 'error'.

wgslender.reportUnusedDisableDirectives.description: Report wgslender-disable comments that don't suppress any diagnostic.

wgslender.lsp.inlayHints.enabled.description: Master switch for wgslender inlay hints (type annotations, const values, minify size insights).

wgslender.lsp.inlayHints.typeAnnotations.description: Show inferred-type inlay hints (let types, expression result types). Off by default.

wgslender.lsp.diagnostics.enabled.description: Publish wgslender diagnostics (validation errors, lint warnings, minify hints).

wgslender.lsp.lint.enabled.description: Run the configured lint packs (`extends`, defaulting to @wgslender/recommended) as part of diagnostics. Turning this off leaves validation errors but removes all lint warnings, including unused-symbol and dead-code.

wgslender.lsp.minifyMode.description: Minifier inlay-hint mode (off / insights show estimated bytes / strict escalates minify rules to errors).

wgslender.lsp.minifyInsights.format.description: Format for minify-size inlay hints: delta (saved bytes), bytes (absolute minified size), or both.

wgslender.lsp.minifyInsights.functionSiz.description: Show estimated minified size at each function declaration.

wgslender.lsp.minifyInsights.declSize.description: Show estimated minified size at each top-level declaration (struct, const, var, alias, override).

wgslender.lsp.minifyInsights.totalSize.description: Show total estimated minified size as a code lens at the top of the document.

wgslender.lsp.minifyLints.enabled.description: Run minify-pack lint rules (M01xx hygiene checks). Auto-enabled when `lsp.minifyMode` is `strict`.

wgslender.lsp.minifyLints.budgetBytes.description: Per-shader minified size budget in bytes. When set, M0500 (`minify/shader-exceeds-size-budget`) fires above this threshold; the total-size code lens renders an over-budget badge. null = no budget (M0500 stays a no-op).

wgslender.lsp.minifyEstimator.useFullMin.description: Run the production minifier + gzip-of-output for ground-truth byte counts. Slower to recompute on every edit; default uses the cheap length-only heuristic.

wgslender.minifyWhitespace.description: Strip insignificant whitespace when minifying. Used by Minify Preview / Save Minified As / Compile and by the LSP estimator.

wgslender.minifySyntax.description: Apply WGSL syntax-level optimizations when minifying.

wgslender.treeShaking.description: Eliminate code unreachable from any entry point when minifying.

wgslender.preserveUniformStructTypes.description: Keep struct types referenced by uniform/storage vars when minifying.

wgslender.mangleExternalBindings.description: Rename @group/@binding vars directly when minifying. By default wgslender keeps these names and emits `let` aliases so the host pipeline can keep using the original names. The LSP also reads this knob to gate the M0100 hint — to silence M0100 without changing minifier behavior, use `"rules": { "minify/external-binding-blocks-rename": "off" }`.

wgslender.sortDeclarations.description: Sort top-level declarations to improve DEFLATE compression.

wgslender.scopeLocalRename.description: Rename function-local symbols using a per-scope counter to improve DEFLATE compression.

wgslender.keepNames.description: Names that must not be renamed by the minifier.

wgslender.validate.strict.description: Treat all validation warnings as errors.

wgslender.compile.outputDirectory.description: Default output directory for `compile`. Empty means alongside the source file.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run build
